features.statement: Page uses semantic landmark elements (header, main, section, footer, address) to structure content.
Headings are live styled text rather than images of script lettering; only a few graphics remain.
Every image carries an alt attribute, with descriptive rewritten alt text and more ARIA attributes.
Markup is lean: few scripts, no external stylesheets, minimal meta tags, no inline style attributes, and few classes.
Heading outline is shallow, with no h1 and a call-to-action phrase marked up as a heading.
Layout is a single centered column of stacked full-width horizontal bands, without a sidebar.
Header places a shrunken main logo in one row alongside smaller sub-brand logos.
Hero images are scaled up and slides are stacked in one centered fixed-width frame.
Sections are separated by alternating solid-color bands (navy, off-white, mid-blue) instead of dotted rules.
Palette is white, dark navy, mid-blue and an amber/orange accent, with white as the dominant text color.
Intro text is large, centered, white serif on a dark navy band, with brand names in bold.
Section headings are larger, centered, and underlined with a short orange accent bar.
Promo images sit in white padded bordered card frames with generous spacing between them.
Contact block is a full-width mid-blue band with a large centered bold white phone call-to-action heading.
Footer is dark navy with all content centered, including a wide centered light gray-blue legal line.
Accreditation logo strip is enlarged and set on a white rounded plate.
Back-to-top control is a pill-shaped outlined text button with an arrow.
Carousel indicators are small dots, with a gold active dot and hollow white-outlined inactive dots.
Surfaces use more box shadows and transforms for depth, such as a drop shadow on the hero.
Copy is condensed: fewer words, with product lists and article teasers dropped, and fewer decorative images.
Page title lists the product brands instead of a search-oriented category phrase.
